title: XcodeBuildMCP
summary: XcodeBuildMCP is an open-source MCP server and CLI that gives coding agents structured access to Apple-platform build, test, simulator, device, logging, debugging, and UI-automation workflows. It turns the normally manual Xcode feedback loop into callable evidence an external agent can use to recover from errors.
takeaway: Pilot XcodeBuildMCP in a sandboxed repository and require every agent task to finish with a clean build, targeted test results, and a simulator screenshot or log bundle attached for review.
